title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
单中品灵石就有上千万之多，还有各式各样的法宝，叶辰在心里将五长老狠狠痛骂了一顿。这五长老是克扣了宗门弟子多少修炼资源，才积累下如此丰厚的家当，不过现在都便宜叶辰了。叶辰忍不住露出一口大白牙，这五长老半辈子都为他忙活了。叶辰将所有法宝收起，这些法宝他根本看不上，只等寻个机会拿出去卖掉换灵石。叶辰接着将所有灵石，包括下注所得，总计一千两百万，全部放入天道珠，试图冲击修为封印。等到所有灵石消耗一空，叶辰的修为仅仅恢复到筑基四重。气得叶辰又在心里将无极仙帝狠狠臭骂了一通，心都在滴血，满脸肉疼。骂完无极仙帝，叶辰再次将修为隐藏起来，只显露出练气一重的修为。次日一早，五长老的惨叫声响彻整个天玄宗。众人闻声赶来，只见五长老的洞府一片狼藉，而五长老本人更是鼻青脸肿，躺在地上。“是谁？！是谁干的？！”五长老愤怒地咆哮着，声音中充满了悲愤和绝望。众弟子面面相觑，谁也不敢轻易出声。这时，宗主玄机真人闻讯赶来，看到五长老的惨状，脸色阴沉得可怕。“这到底是怎么回事？”宗主怒喝道。“宗主，我不知道啊，昨晚突然有个神秘人闯进来就对我一顿暴打，还抢走了我的法宝和乾坤袋。”五长老挣扎着爬起来，向宗主哭诉。“你可有看清那人的模样？”玄机真人问道。“是一个从未见过的中年男子，不是本宗之人，出手极其狠辣。”五长老满脸悲愤，眼眶通红，无奈地摇了摇头。玄机真人皱了皱眉，宗门被陌生人闯入竟然没人发现。玄机真人沉思片刻，说道：“此事我定会彻查，你先好好养伤。”而始作俑者叶辰睡到日上三竿才起床。他伸着懒腰，打着哈欠走出房门，一副悠然自得的模样。叶辰看到周围都是紧张兮兮的巡逻弟子，心中暗笑，肯定是五长老被打的事传开了，脸上却装出一副疑惑好奇的表情。“这是怎么了？宗门弟子怎么都这么紧张？”叶辰故意向旁边的弟子问道。“你不知道？五长老昨晚被人打成重伤了？”旁边弟子一脸怀疑。“什么？！”叶辰故作惊讶，“五长老被人打了？这是谁干的，太嚣张了吧！”“我们也不知道是谁干的。”那弟子摇头道，“宗门正在严查。”整个宗门都展开了严查，然而经过一番查探，所有阵法都未发现有人闯入过的痕迹。叶辰对这些事丝毫不在意，在宗门内悠然闲逛，毕竟根本就没有外人闯入，打人的就是他自己。他在宗门内与各种弟子攀谈，旁敲侧击地打听宗门情况。比如谁最为富有之类的。他叶辰最喜欢“助人为乐”了，尤其是帮助那些有钱人。对，就是帮助，绝对不是打劫！

但在与弟子攀谈中，叶辰得知宗门后山有一座禁地，只是无人知晓禁地内究竟有何事物。叶辰决定去一探究竟，当他潜入禁地后发现，禁地内竟然是一座灵石矿脉。这是泼天的富贵啊！叶辰嘴都咧到耳后根了。‘哈哈，将这个灵石矿挖了，足够我恢复修为了，到时候在这苍兰大陆我就可以横着走了。’叶辰围着灵石矿脉转了一圈，眉头微皱。“哎！这竟然是给护宗大阵提供能量的矿脉！将灵石都挖走了，大阵就土崩瓦解了！”叶辰思考着要不要挖，护宗大阵没了，天玄宗就没有了防守，完全暴露在外了，容易被人攻破。“挖一小半问题不大，等我修为恢复了，小小一个护宗阵法随便就能重新布置一个。”叶辰考虑片刻后还是决定挖，毕竟这泼天富贵就在眼前，完全放弃不是他的风格。他拿出工具便开始挖灵石，只是挖着挖着一道声音在叶辰耳边响起。“好徒儿，你在干嘛呀？”苏太虚无声无息地出现在叶辰身后，贱兮兮的给叶辰来了一个问候。叶辰吓得一激灵，手里挖矿的工具都掉地上了，转身看见是苏太虚松了口气。“是老苏啊，你吓我一跳。”叶辰一边说着，一边抬手擦了擦额头上并不存在的汗。“你修为怎么回事？”苏太虚看见叶辰只显示练气一重修为，微微皱眉道。“额！我这不是为了低调嘛！”叶辰挠了挠头，露出一抹狡黠的笑容。苏太虚听了叶辰的回答，嘴角微微抽动，你这练气期的修为还有必要低调吗？忽然，苏太虚回过神来，直接跳起来，揪起叶辰的耳朵道：“嘿！你个臭小子，你刚才叫我什么？”“哎呀，疼疼疼，老苏你听我解释啊！我不能叫你师傅，这是为你好。”叶辰疼得龇牙咧嘴，慌忙求饶解释。“为我好？你这小子满嘴胡言，给我解释清楚！”苏太虚眉头紧皱，他决定，要是叶辰的解释不满意，就要关他几天禁闭了。叶辰已经认定苏太虚就是自己师兄了，叫师傅那是绝对不可能的，太别扭了，实在叫不出口。他瞬间收起笑容，开始了他的表演。他换上一副痛苦至极的表情，眼眶泛红，声音也变得哽咽起来。“老苏，我曾经有一个师傅，我对他那是毕恭毕敬，言听计从。”说到这里，叶辰的泪水在眼眶里打转。他颤抖着声音继续说道：“可是，他不待见我，经常对我打骂，直到有一天，他知道我在外面做好事，助人为乐后，他大发雷霆，废除了我的修为，将我逐出了师门。”叶辰说的那是撕心裂肺，声泪俱下，痛苦万分，眼泪都顺着脸颊滚滚流下。而此时的叶辰，仿佛真的沉浸在那痛苦的回忆中，无法自拔。这演技要是换在现代，妥妥的要给他颁发一个国际影视大奖。而心里却在默念。“老头子啊！你可不要怪我啊！是你自己不当人，将师兄贬下界的，还要把我也贬下界。”他继续说道：“我经常在心里骂我师傅。”说道这里叶辰加重了口气。“骂的很难听，很阴毒的那种。”
content_en:
There were tens of millions of medium-grade spiritual stones alone, as well as various magic weapons. Ye Chen scolded the fifth elder severely in his heart.These fifth elders deducted many cultivation resources from the disciples of the sect to accumulate such a rich fortune, but now they are all at Ye Chen's advantage.Ye Chen couldn't help but show his big white teeth. The fifth elder had been busy for him for half his life.Ye Chen put away all the magic weapons. He didn't care about these magic weapons at all. He just waited for an opportunity to sell them for spiritual stones.Ye Chen then put all the spiritual stones, including the income from betting, totaling 12 million, into the Tiandaozhu, trying to break the cultivation seal.When all the spirit stones were consumed, Ye Chen's cultivation level only returned to the fourth level of foundation building.Ye Chen was so angry that he scolded Wuji Immortal Emperor in his heart again, his heart was bleeding and his face was full of pain.After scolding the Wuji Immortal Emperor, Ye Chen hid his cultivation again, revealing only the first level of Qi training.Early the next morning, the screams of the fifth elders resounded throughout Tianxuan Sect.When everyone heard the sound and rushed over, they saw that the fifth elder's cave was in a mess, and the fifth elder himself was lying on the ground with a bruised nose and a swollen face."Who?! Who did this?!" the fifth elder roared angrily, his voice full of grief, anger and despair.All the disciples looked at each other, no one dared to speak easily.At this time, Master Xuanji, the leader of the sect, came after hearing the news. Seeing the miserable condition of the fifth elder, his face was terrifyingly gloomy."What on earth is going on?" the sect leader shouted angrily."Sect Master, I don't know. Last night, a mysterious man suddenly broke in and beat me up. He also took away my magic weapon and Qiankun Bag." The fifth elder struggled to get up and cried to the Sect Master."Have you seen that person's appearance clearly?" Master Xuanji asked."It was a middle-aged man I had never seen before. He was not a member of our sect. He was extremely ruthless." The fifth elder's face was full of grief and anger, his eyes were red, and he shook his head helplessly.Master Xuanji frowned, no one noticed that the sect was broken into by a stranger.Master Xuanji thought for a moment and said, "I will investigate this matter thoroughly. You should take good care of your injuries first." The instigator, Ye Chen, slept until three o'clock in the morning before getting up.He stretched, yawned and walked out of the room, looking leisurely and contented.Seeing the nervous patrolling disciples surrounding him, Ye Chen secretly smiled inwardly. The news about the fifth elder being beaten must have spread, but he pretended to have a puzzled and curious expression on his face."What's going on? Why are the disciples of the sect so nervous?" Ye Chen deliberately asked the disciple next to him."You don't know? The fifth elder was seriously injured last night?" The disciple next to him looked suspicious."What?!" Ye Chen pretended to be surprised, "The fifth elder was beaten? Who did this? It's too arrogant!" "We don't know who did it." The disciple shook his head and said, "The sect is conducting a strict investigation." The entire sect launched a strict investigation, but after some investigation, no trace of intrusion was found in any formation.Ye Chen didn't care at all about these things and wandered around the sect leisurely. After all, no outsiders broke in at all, and he was the one who beat people.He chatted with various disciples in the sect and inquired about the sect's situation.Like who is the richest or something like that.He, Ye Chen, likes to "help others" the most, especially helping those who are rich.Yes, it’s just help, definitely not robbery!

But while talking with his disciples, Ye Chen learned that there was a forbidden area in the mountain behind the sect, but no one knew what was in the forbidden area.Ye Chen decided to find out what was going on. When he sneaked into the forbidden area, he discovered that there was actually a vein of spiritual stone in the forbidden area.This is heaven-shaking wealth!Ye Chen grinned to the back of his ears.‘Haha, digging this spiritual stone mine will be enough for me to restore my cultivation. Then I can walk sideways in this Canglan Continent.’ Ye Chen circled around the spirit stone veins and frowned slightly."Hey! This turns out to be the mineral vein that provides energy for the sect-protecting formation! If all the spiritual stones are dug away, the formation will fall apart!" Ye Chen thought about whether to dig. With the sect-protecting formation gone, Tianxuan Sect would have no defense. It was completely exposed and could easily be breached."It's not a big problem to dig half of it. When my cultivation level recovers, I can easily rearrange a small sect-protecting formation." Ye Chen decided to dig after thinking for a moment. After all, this huge wealth is right in front of him, and giving up completely is not his style.He took out his tools and started digging for spiritual stones. As he was digging, a sound rang in Ye Chen's ears."Good disciple, what are you doing?" Su Taixu appeared behind Ye Chen silently and gave Ye Chen a mean greeting.Ye Chen was so frightened that all the mining tools in his hands fell to the ground. He turned around and breathed a sigh of relief when he saw it was Su Taixu."It's Lao Su, you scared me." Ye Chen said as he raised his hand to wipe the non-existent sweat on his forehead."What's wrong with your cultivation?" Su Taixu frowned slightly when he saw that Ye Chen only showed the first level of Qi training."Uh! I'm not doing this just to keep a low profile!" Ye Chen scratched his head and showed a sly smile.Su Taixu's mouth twitched slightly after hearing Ye Chen's answer. Is it necessary for you to keep a low profile during your Qi training period?Suddenly, Su Taixu came to his senses, jumped up, grabbed Ye Chen's ears and said, "Hey! You brat, what did you call me just now?" "Oh, it hurts, it hurts, old Su, please listen to my explanation! I can't call you master, this is for your own good." Ye Chen grinned in pain and hurriedly begged for mercy and explanation."For my own good? You are talking nonsense, please explain it to me!" Su Taixu frowned, and he decided that if Ye Chen was not satisfied with his explanation, he would be detained for a few days.Ye Chen has already determined that Su Taixu is his senior brother. It is absolutely impossible to call him master. It is too awkward and he really can't say it.He instantly put away his smile and started his performance.He put on an expression of extreme pain, his eyes were red, and his voice became choked."Lao Su, I once had a master. I was respectful to him and obeyed his instructions." At this point, tears welled up in Ye Chen's eyes.He continued with a trembling voice: "However, he didn't like me and often beat and scolded me. Until one day, when he knew that I was doing good things outside and helping others, he became furious, abolished my cultivation, and expelled me from the school." What Ye Chen said was heartbreaking, tearful, and extremely painful, with tears rolling down his cheeks.At this time, Ye Chen seemed to be really immersed in those painful memories, unable to extricate himself.If this acting skills were available in modern times, he would be awarded an international film and television award.But I was thinking silently in my heart."Old man! Don't blame me! You are the one who demoted your senior brother to the lower world. You want to demote me to the lower world as well." He continued: "I often scold my master in my heart." Ye Chen said with a heavier tone."The scolding was very unpleasant and vicious."
